plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 skin RNA-seq samples (6 AD-lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts) are analyzed for differential expression and hallmark pathway activity. Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median; per grounded guidance (R-0008/R-0030) it is kept through QC, inspected on PCA/sample-distance/library-size plots, and only removed if it shows a stated defect (outlier clustering or identity doubt) rather than depth alone — DESeq2 size factors already account for depth. The pipeline: (1) sample-structure QC with blind VST, PCA and sample-distance heatmap; (2) minimal pre-filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smaller group size) followed by DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization and a Wald test on ~condition (Control as reference) with apeglm LFC shrinkage, BH-FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, cross-checked against an edgeR quasi-likelihood fit for robustness (report the intersection as high-confidence); (3) fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against the 50 MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets, with Reactome as a secondary collection, respecting the 15-500 gene set size window and reporting leading-edge genes; (4) an integrated report presenting the DE gene table (unshrunken and shrunken LFC, padj), QC/outlier handling rationale, fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), enrichment tables with rank metric/database/version stated, and a full reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package and gene-set versions).
